data.name: Favored Terrain
data.description: A holy guide chooses a favored terrain from the ranger favored terrains table. This otherwise functions like the ranger ability of the same name. This ability replaces the mercy gained at 3rd level. Every time a holy guide would be able to select another mercy, he can instead select another favored terrain and increase his bonuses for one existing favored terrain, just like a ranger.
